rules: Effects of the same type do not stack. Only the strongest one applies.
Effects not listed here are their own type and stack with everything else.
Items from the same upgrade series never stack with each other, even when their type is different.

categories.name: Skill damage increase
categories.note: Almost everything here stacks. Most ally buffs fall in this category, and hero skills scale with the caster's stats. Items from the same series still don't stack: Priest's E → E plus Eye of the Blood God stacks, but Eye of the Flame Lord plus Eye of the Blood God doesn't (only Eye of the Blood God applies).
